title: Asymmetric Bidirectional Predictive Dynamics in Google Search and COVID-19 Time Series: A Multi-Horizon Forecast-Error Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.28563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online search activity is widely used as a digital trace of information seeking during epidemics, but its predictive value is often reduced to correlation, a selected lag, or a single forecast-error score. We examine eight pre-specified Google Trends-COVID-19 pairs in both directions using matched LightGBM forecasts over rolling 400-day windows and horizons of 1-14 days. Log-RMSE gain is combined with forecast-error distribution entropy (FEDE), which captures horizon-dependent changes in the signed error distribution. The resulting directional predictive signature comprises response class, RMSE effect, FEDE endpoint and early-slope responses, persistence across rolling regimes, and horizon profile. translated_title: 谷歌搜索与COVID-19时间序列中的不对称双向预测动态：一项多预测期预测误差分析
translated_abstract: 在线搜索活动被广泛用作疫情期间信息寻求行为的数字痕迹，但其预测价值往往被简化为相关性、某个选定的滞后阶数或单一的预测误差分数。我们在双向方向上检验了八个预先指定的谷歌趋势-COVID-19数据对，采用匹配的LightGBM预测模型，在滚动400天窗口和1-14天的预测期上进行分析。我们将对数RMSE增益与预测误差分布熵（FEDE）相结合，后者能够捕捉带符号误差分布随预测期变化的情况。由此得到的方向性预测特征包括响应类别、RMSE效应、FEDE端点与早期斜率响应、在滚动机制间的持续性以及预测期轮廓。为筛选候选方向，我们还引入了相对持久性加权的方向性预测响应强度（DPRS），采用研究内0-100的量表；100表示比较集中观察到的最强响应，而非绝对意义上的
tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合对数RMSE增益与预测误差分布熵（FEDE）及持久性加权DPRS评分的多预测期预测误差分析框架，揭示了谷歌搜索与COVID-19时间序列之间双向预测关系的非对称动态特征。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multi-horizon forecast-error analysis framework combining log-RMSE gains, forecast-error distribution entropy (FEDE), and a persistence-weighted DPRS score to reveal asymmetric bidirectional predictive dynamics between Google Trends and COVID-19 time series.
